title: Choose the visual world for the Seafin homepage
question: The roll landed on the Equipment Nameplate. Keep it, take the pick, take the category standard, or re-roll. Three more dealt worlds wait in the re-roll pool.

options.label: The Equipment Nameplate
options.lineage: engraved rating plates on equipment a business owns
options.thesis: AI as equipment you own: plated, installed where you choose, serviced by the person who built it.
options.viewport: One full-width anodized plate: 'Your AI department' engraved large, the three services as plate fields, where it runs, who services it, and a stamped 'Book a discovery call' button; Wardix's real console starts just below.
options.risk: Brushed-metal skeuomorphism dates fast; it has to be flat anodized color and crisp engraving, never a photo texture, and no fake serial numbers.

raised.raise: One label column (Service, Runs on, Serviced by) runs down the whole page; every section is a row on it.
One strict engraving grid: every line of type sits on the plate's ruled grid, nothing off-grid.
One field engraved at monumental scale: who owns what gets built.

options.label: The Industrial Supply Catalog
options.thesis: Services and products listed like specified parts: exact, dense, line-drawn, nothing hyped.
options.viewport: A catalog page: the three services and Wardix as numbered entries with line drawings and spec rows, the discovery call as the order button.
options.risk: Catalogs live on prices and yours are hidden; and the utilitarian-catalog look is a known favourite many design-led sites already borrow.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: The site as a broadcast index of numbered pages.
options.viewport: Page 100 index, consulting and Wardix on their own numbered pages.
options.case: Very clear structure, but US small-business owners don't know teletext; it reads as novelty.
options.kept: A strict grid nothing sits off.

options.label: Mesophotic Deep Dive
options.thesis: Scrolling as a descent, services as depth stops.
options.viewport: A descent from turquoise surface to dark depth.
options.case: It's the literal 'Seafin = ocean' reading; regulated-business owners don't identify with technical diving, and depth hides the offer.
options.kept: One vertical axis rules every line.

options.label: Anime Command Wall
options.thesis: Monitoring as a crisis wall of readings and countdowns.
options.viewport: An orange-on-black wall of Wardix readings.
options.case: Neon on black is the AI-site cliché, and an alarm wall frightens the owner it should reassure.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What small AI consultancies ship, executed well.
canonCard.viewport: Outcome headline and a book-a-call button beside the founder's photo, three service cards, a process strip, FAQ.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other AI consultancy, by design.
